title: Read-only precheck before the first live Calm DECIDE/OBSERVE window

headline.why: the running scheduler predates the slot change by four hours and holds the old table in memory; until it is restarted the two phase jobs exist only in the code, and the stale job it will fire produces NO ledger row at all

running_process.evidence: the scheduler's own log line: 'Track 1 SHADOW slots registered: 70'

scheduler_registration_from_real_constru.caveat: true in the CODE only; the live process has the opposite of all four

stale_scheduler_consequence.why_it_matters: the refusal is raised before the window ledger is opened, so the window leaves no row; the audit reads no row as 'nobody looked', which is strictly worse than yesterday's recorded refusal
stale_scheduler_consequence.precedent: the same failure mode Stage 5Q-3 eliminated for splice refusals

restart_window.if_missed: better missed than half-done: a decide phase that never ran plus an observe phase that runs anyway produces a refusal row saying there was no decision to observe, which is correct and is not evidence

adjacency_risk.what: TRACK1_CALM_DECIDE_0932 fires one minute after track1_maxhold_exit
adjacency_risk.history: that job wrote the Track 1 book at 09:31:13 on 2026-08-26, the corruption Stage 5ZS repaired
adjacency_risk.verdict: thin but real; watch on the first day rather than assume

runtime_filesystem_baseline.book_move_cause: the overnight Nikkei window closing; the route wrote its own state
runtime_filesystem_baseline.note: the fourth window close the Stage 5ZS repair has survived

evidence_reader.important: that Calm run happened BEFORE the Stage 5ZU timing fix landed, so the most recent live Calm result does not measure the current code. No live Calm window has ever run against either the 5ZU fix or the 5ZX phases.

gap_found_and_closed.gap: deleting the phase branch from the scheduler left every test in the corpus green; nothing asserted that the process launcher passes a phase
gap_found_and_closed.significance: a mechanism built and its wiring left unproven — the fifth time in this programme
gap_found_and_closed.closed_by: test_16, which fires the real registered jobs with the launcher replaced and reads the argv they build
mutations_it_catches: a phase leaking into the three unsplit sleeves

repairs_owned_by_this_precheck.why: bidirectional by design; Stage 5ZX added a row without declaring it and the pin caught exactly that
repairs_owned_by_this_precheck.repair: the row is declared, which also brings it under the per-row rendering check

repairs_owned_by_this_precheck.what: the argv extractor in an older suite
repairs_owned_by_this_precheck.why: it read the launcher's first argument only as a single list literal; the 5ZX narrowing made it a concatenation, so it stopped finding the call and reported 'no launch call' — which reads like the wiring was removed rather than reshaped
repairs_owned_by_this_precheck.repair: flattens a concatenation and reports both branches of a conditional
repairs_owned_by_this_precheck.proof: a removed flag still disappears from what the assertions read; mutations confirm

why_it_grew: one new parametrised case: 'Calm phases' joining the dashboard fact list

noise_detail.what_it_asserts: a browser assertion that the blocker tooltip carries the B1 id
noise_detail.relation_to_this_work: none — it does not touch the row this stage added
noise_detail.classification: the corpus's known order dependence, not a repair; counted as noise rather than credited

after_this_precheck.verified_by: diffing the two failure lists, not by comparing totals

regression.bucket_method: the same failures re-run with the pre-stage slot table restored through a probe fixture; 45 turned green. Not read off the test names.
true_5zx_regressions_detail: test_track1_stage5d_shadow_live_wiring_20260823.py — two cases behind the argv extractor

order_dependence.observed: the same set produced 109 failures then 98
order_dependence.meaning: eleven tests pass or fail depending on what ran before them
order_dependence.implication: any count taken from this corpus carries about ten per cent of noise

left_red_and_listed.why_not_repaired: the count pins are the roster anti-pattern already on record; the ones driving the old slot exercise 10:00 semantics that no longer exist, and repairing them means deciding per test what the new Calm timing should mean — weakening assertions inside a precheck that nobody asked to weaken them in

correction.why_missed: this classification grouped failures by their message text, and the fourth failed with different wording ('_track1_body argv not found' rather than 'no _run([...]) call found'), so it landed in the pre-existing bucket
correction.lesson: grouping by symptom is faster than reading each failure, and it put a genuine regression in the wrong pile
correction.why_it_matters: that test asserts no order flag can reach a Track 1 slot, and it had stopped running

focused_tests_run.scratch/test_track1_stage5d_shadow_live_: argv cases pass; 4 slot-id cases remain in the split bucket

still_blocked_before_paper: the scheduler restart — new, and now the first thing; until it happens the two jobs exist only in the code
PAPER_SHADOW_EVIDENCE — 3 judgeable days of 5, 0 carrying Calm evidence, and all three are FAIL days
B1 — no decision recorded; its measurement expires 2026-08-27T11:34:00-04:00
the SEND wire — does not exist

next_event_to_watch.first: the scheduler restart, in a quiet gap before 09:32 ET
next_event_to_watch.then: 2026-08-27 09:32 ET — TRACK1_CALM_DECIDE_0932, the first run of either phase in production
next_event_to_watch.what_success_looks_like: a shadow_intent file appears for the session, carrying a DECIDE row with no price and an OBSERVE row whose reference equals the 10:00 open; the day classifies decision_judgeable; the orders directory stays absent
next_event_to_watch.what_to_check_immediately_after: the book envelope is still schema 2 and route-stamped, given the max-hold job runs one minute earlier

findings_recorded_not_fixed.what: ops.py status never prints the stale-scheduler warning that ops.py already has
findings_recorded_not_fixed.detail: describe_scheduler_state exists and its docstring names this precedent — '21 backend restarts read as full restarts while a scheduler from three days earlier kept running a cron table that no longer matched the code'. It is called from exactly one place, the restart path.
findings_recorded_not_fixed.effect: the read-only command an operator runs to check health is the one command that does not say the in-memory schedule no longer matches the code
findings_recorded_not_fixed.why_not_fixed_here: this stage is a read-only precheck and status is the instrument being read; changing an instrument during a measurement is the wrong order
